source_text: Ultima homilia: Moyses incohavit, Iesus consummavit. Lex umbra; Christus veritas. Transitus Iordanis baptismus; Hiericho mundus; sortes charismata.
pass_a_gloss: Last homily: Moses began, Jesus completed. Law shadow; Christ truth. Crossing of-Jordan baptism; Jericho world; lots gifts.
pass_b_english: Last homily: Moses began; Jesus finished. The law is shadow; Christ is truth. Jordan’s crossing is baptism; Jericho the world; the lots are gifts.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
